description: This script automates the process of diffing a downstream Android repository against its upstream. It handles repo initialization, synchronization, retrieving build IDs, and performing diffs between repositories, with configurable parameters for URLs, branches, tags, and exclusions.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for repository URLs, branches, tags, exclusions, and error handling options.

methods.name: repo_init
methods.description: Initializes a repo workspace with a specific manifest URL and revision.

methods.name: repo_sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the repo workspace, with retries and optional error ignoring.

methods.name: get_commit_with_keyword
methods.description: Retrieves the latest commit hash in a project directory matching a specific keyword.

methods.name: get_build_id
methods.description: Extracts the BUILD_ID from the build_id.mk file in the workspace.

methods.name: repo_sync_specific_release
methods.description: Performs repo initialization and synchronization for a specific release tag.

methods.name: diff
methods.description: Coordinates the process of syncing downstream and upstream repositories and performing a diff between them.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that parses arguments and initiates the diff process.
